name: 77095 · Houston, TX
findings: ZIP 77095 (Houston) has 214 nonprofit organizations. 92 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 75 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77095 (Houston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 77095 (Houston) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 75 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 17 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 10 hobby and sports organizations here list membership, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.
